t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Honestly, the beginning of the advice I was just given was somewhat hard to understand. However, towards the end summary, the advice was easier to understand and comprehend. The advice from a previous participant gave me, was to keep the basket when the number of mushrooms are higher and change baskets when the amount of mushrooms are lower. For example on the 1x mutiplier rounds, I should take a risk by switching to a different color basket to see if it gives me a higher amount of mushrooms. However on the 5x multiplier rounds, stay with the color basket you have to get the most mushrooms, unless you are getting consistent low amount of mushrooms. Also, what I understood from his words of advice, was for me to stick with the basket until the number of shrooms are below 2. At any amount lower I should switch the color of my basket. My main understanding of this advice was that the strategy was completely random, but once you get the hang of it the game will get easier and the strategy will come to me naturally.

vb_textbox.text: My very simple advice is to get a few rounds under your belt first before taking the advice I am giving because you must get a feel for the game in general. Once you do that you will notice all the lighter color gnomes get a yellow basket and the darker gnomes get a red basket. I found that the gnomes with the red basket generally have the higher amount of mushrooms. However, the yellow basket is generally between 5-10 mushrooms most of the time! Good luck to you! Lastly, keep in mind it is all random, so go with the flow! I personally did not recognize any specific patterns, other than when the numbers start getting low, switch up the color of the gnome a few times, then generally stick with the red basket gnomes!
